4inrow: Four in a Row: drop discs to line up four before the other player.
air_mouse: Uses the Flipper with a BMI160 or LSM6DS3 motion sensor as an air mouse over USB or Bluetooth.
asteroids: The classic Asteroids game: steer a ship and shoot the rocks.
bad_kb: Runs keyboard scripts (Ducky syntax) over USB or Bluetooth, with chosen keyboard layouts.
blackjack: The card game Blackjack against the dealer.
can_commander: Reads and sends CAN bus messages through an external CAN board, with a dashboard.
chess: Chess against the Flipper or another player.
chief_cooker: Receives, decodes, edits and sends restaurant pager signals on Sub-GHz.
coleco: Turns the Flipper into a ColecoVision controller for an RC2014 computer module.
color_guess: Shows a color on the LED and asks for its hex code, against the clock.
counter: A counter raised and lowered with the arrow keys.
doom: A small first-person shooter in the style of Doom.
esp32_wifi_marauder: Drives an ESP32 board running Marauder firmware for Wi-Fi scans and attacks.
esp8266_ifttt_virtual_button: Triggers an IFTTT webhook through an ESP8266 board on the GPIO header.
esp_flasher: Flashes firmware to an ESP chip connected to the GPIO header's UART.
example_adc: Developer example that reads analog voltages on the GPIO pins with the ADC.
example_advanced_plugins: Developer example of an app that loads plugins which call back into the app.
example_apps_assets: Developer example that reads data files shipped with the app in its assets folder.
example_apps_data: Developer example that stores user data in the app's own data folder.
example_ble_beacon: Developer example that broadcasts a custom Bluetooth LE beacon.
example_custom_font: Developer example that draws text with a custom font.
example_date_time_input: Developer example of the view for entering a date and a time.
example_event_loop_event_flags: Developer example of the event loop reacting to event flags, shown with key presses.
example_event_loop_multi: Developer example of one event loop handling several event sources.
example_event_loop_mutex: Developer example of the event loop waiting on a mutex.
example_event_loop_stream_buffer: Developer example of the event loop reading a stream buffer.
example_event_loop_timer: Developer example of timers driven by the event loop.
example_images: Developer example that draws the app's own icons and images.
example_number_input: Developer example of the keyboard for entering a whole number within bounds.
example_plugins: Developer example of an app that loads one plugin file.
example_plugins_multi: Developer example of an app that loads several plugin files.
example_thermo: Developer example that reads a DS18B20 1-Wire thermometer on the GPIO header.
example_view_dispatcher: Developer example of switching between views with the view dispatcher.
example_view_holder: Developer example of showing a single view with a view holder.
flappy_bird: A Flappy Bird game with a high score.
flipp_pomodoro: A Pomodoro timer for focus and break periods.
flipper_atomicdiceroller: Rolls dice from the randomness of a Geiger counter board on the GPIO header.
fm_radio: Tunes an FM radio board (TEA5767) on the GPIO header, with presets and seek.
fmtx_app: Transmits audio on FM through a KT0803 board on the GPIO header.
game15: The sliding puzzle 15: put the numbered tiles in order.
geometry_dash: A side-scrolling game in the style of Geometry Dash, with levels.
ghost_esp: Drives an ESP32 board running GhostESP firmware for Wi-Fi and Bluetooth scans.
gpio: Controls the GPIO pins, the 5 V output and the USB-UART bridge.
gpio_badge: Runs light patterns on the LEDs of a GPIO diagnostics board.
gpio_controller: Sets and reads each GPIO pin from a picture of the header.
gpio_reader_b: Reads the GPIO pins as inputs, with pull-up or pull-down.
i2ctools: Scans, sniffs and sends commands on an I2C bus wired to the GPIO header.
ibutton: Reads, saves, writes and emulates iButton (1-Wire) keys.
iconedit: Draws icons and animations on the Flipper and sends them to a computer.
infrared: Learns, saves and sends infrared remote signals, with universal remotes.
iso15693_nfc_writer: Reads, writes and locks the memory of ISO 15693 NFC tags (ICODE SLIX), and sets their AFI and DSFID.
jetpack_joyride: A side-scrolling jetpack game with obstacles and coins.
key_copier: Measures the bitting of a physical key laid on the screen.
lfrfid: Reads, saves, writes and emulates 125 kHz RFID cards and tags.
lidar_emulator: Sends the infrared signals of LIDAR speed guns, while OK is held.
malveke_gb_cartridge: Reads and writes Game Boy and Game Boy Color cartridges with a MALVEKE board.
malveke_gba_cartridge: Reads and writes Game Boy Advance cartridges with a MALVEKE board.
metronome: A metronome with a set tempo, beats and sound or vibration.
multi_dice: Rolls several kinds of dice, with a Magic 8-Ball mode.
nfc: Reads, saves, writes and emulates NFC cards and tags.
nrf24batch: Sends batches of commands to devices through an nRF24L01 board.
nrf24scan: Scans, logs and resends nRF24L01 packets with an external board.
passy: Reads electronic passports (eMRTD) over NFC with the holder's document data.
pinball0: Pinball with tables defined in JSON files.
portal_of_flipper: Emulates a toy game's USB portal with figures loaded from NFC files.
qrcode: Shows QR codes stored as files on the SD card.
radio_scanner: Scans Sub-GHz frequencies and plays what it hears on the speaker.
seader: Reads HID iClass, DESFire and Seos credentials with a SAM and UART adapter.
simon_says: The memory game Simon Says with the arrow keys.
subghz: Reads, saves and sends Sub-GHz remote signals, and analyzes the frequency in use.
subghz_bruteforcer: Sends every code of a Sub-GHz remote protocol in turn, to find a working one.
t5577_writer: Writes raw blocks to T5577 RFID tags, from settings or a saved file.
tama_p1: Emulates the first Tamagotchi, from a ROM put on the SD card.
tanks: A tanks battle game on a maze of walls.
u2f: Works as a U2F security key over USB for two-factor sign-in.
